description: This file defines the 'Article' model class within the Opencart platform, responsible for handling operations related to CMS articles such as retrieving articles, comments, updating ratings, and managing article-layout associations.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Model class for managing CMS articles within the Opencart platform, including functionalities for fetching articles, comments, updating ratings, and related data operations.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific article by ID.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Fetches a list of articles based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching the given filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific article.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a new comment to an article.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Fetches a specific comment by ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves all comments for a specific article with optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Returns the total number of comments for a specific article.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific article.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating of a specific comment.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Retrieves the total number of comments for a specific article, optionally filtering by customer or parent comment ID.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Inserts a new rating entry for a specific article comment, linking the rating to the customer and session details.

methods.name: deleteRatings
methods.description: Deletes the rating associated with a specific article comment for the current customer.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Fetches aggregated rating data for an article or a specific comment, grouped by rating value.
